component: EWS operation tracing and result boundaries

quotes.text: `operation_id` and `name` are only used for logging purposes.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The operation gets a UUID before enqueue, and request attempts reuse it rather than creating an ID for every send. Enqueue and receiver-completion logs carry the same ID, but completed is printed before result propagation and does not mean success. Enqueue failure returns earlier. This correlates log phases without adding elapsed-duration measurements or wire identity; the accepted shared sender architecture is a later phase.
title: EWS logging correlates retries with one queued-operation ID
